newsitem.title: CHINA: China to cut tariffs to 15 pct by 2000 - Xinhua.
newsitem.headline: China to cut tariffs to 15 pct by 2000 - Xinhua.

text.p: China will cut import duties to an average of 15 percent by the year 2000, the official Xinhua news agency on Monday quoted Chinese President Jiang Zemin as saying.
Xinhua quoted him as making the remarks at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum in Manila.

Jiang noted that China had already cut its import duties to an average of 23 percent as of this year, following a pledge to cut tariffs at last year's Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum in Osaka, Japan.
"China will bring it (the average tariff) further down to around 15 percent by the year 2000," Jiang was quoted as saying.
"China will continue to support the 'APEC approach', actively participate in Asia-Pacific economic cooperation and make its due contribution to the realisation of our common objectives," Jiang said.
